captions.text: Two teams run the same app. People line up — every person served earns coins.
A wave of extra {visitors} hits Blue — the line grows and people give up.
Blue adds more {servers} (key 1) — the line shrinks.
Fake {visitors} clog Red’s line, so real ones give up.
Red builds a {bouncer} (key 2) to turn bots away.
…but Blue built a {bouncer} first — the bots are turned away!
Blue’s {visitors} walk over to Red — Blue has no {lockAddress}.
Blue sends {jam} — Red’s cards would freeze…
That’s the game — now it’s your turn!
